title: LocalStack S3 (paraphrase)
text: LocalStack emulates AWS services, including S3, for local development and testing. The community edition is open source under the Apache 2.0 license; additional features require a paid plan. Emulation aims for API compatibility, but behaviour can differ from AWS in edge cases.
